summary: Williams Companies furnished an 8-K reporting the September 8, 2026 pricing of a four-tranche investment-grade bond offering: $500M 5.000% senior notes due 2029, $1.0B 5.600% notes due 2033, $750M 5.800% notes due 2036 and $500M 6.400% notes due 2056, totaling $2.75B. Citigroup, Mizuho, Morgan Stanley and SMBC Nikko acted as underwriters; the deal closed September 10, 2026 under an existing Form S-3 shelf, with notes issued under a 2012 indenture via a fourteenth supplemental indenture. This is a routine debt capital raise, not a special situation; watch Treasury spreads, credit ratings and proceeds deployment.
